facts: 34 km long and up to 23 km wide
168 km east of Saint Lucia and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
worth_knowing: The easternmost island of the Lesser Antilles, set apart in the Atlantic. It is flat compared with the Windward Islands to its west, rising gently to the central Scotland District.
